business_problem: Sentara needed one integrated technology ecosystem for its One Sentara transformation, but fragmented support and manual outage handling consumed help-desk time and made it harder to scale consistent employee services across hospitals, health plans, and future expansion markets.
solution_summary: Sentara expanded its long-running ServiceNow estate into the operational backbone for the One Sentara program, using IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, and Virtual Agent to unify employee support and IT planning. IT Service Management provides the 1,500-item service catalog, incident workflows, outage records, and self-service foundation used by staff across hospitals and health-plan operations. Strategic Portfolio Management now holds the full annual resource-planning process, breaking work down across more than 100 resource groups so executives can make resourcing decisions from one dataset. Virtual Agent and portal self-service reduce dependence on manual channels, while the wider platform automates outage reporting and ticket creation through a telephony integration. The result is one ServiceNow environment that handles frontline support, operational automation, and portfolio visibility as Sentara expands into Florida and beyond.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Provides the service catalog, incident workflows, and request management used across Sentara's operations.

solution_components.name: IT Operations Management
solution_components.role: Supports operational issue handling and outage visibility inside the ServiceNow platform.

solution_components.name: Strategic Portfolio Management
solution_components.role: Captures annual resource-planning data and converts it into executive planning views.

solution_components.name: Virtual Agent
solution_components.role: Adds self-service interactions that reduce pressure on live support channels.

data_flow: Service requests, outage records, catalog interactions, and portfolio data are captured in ServiceNow. Virtual Agent and the self-service portal handle routine needs first, the help-desk telephony integration plays outage messages and creates incident tickets for callers, and Strategic Portfolio Management rolls resource and project demand up into executive planning views.
business_outcome: Sentara now runs 100% of annual resource planning in ServiceNow, supports staff through a 1,500-item service catalog, automates outage notifications so agents stay available for higher-priority clinician issues, and uses the same platform foundation to support One Sentara and expansion into Florida.
metrics: 100% Of annual resource planning conducted in ServiceNow
architecture_clues: Outage records are surfaced to callers through a telephony integration that can automatically create a unique incident ticket for each caller.
Resource-planning data is broken down by people and projects across more than 100 resource groups.
